column1: # AGLC4 conformance corpus — case citations (plan 07 T8 seed).
# Format: <input citation line> <TAB> <expected diagnostic codes, comma-separated, '-' for none>
# Edition: aglc4. Each rule ships at least one positive (firing) and one
# negative (silent) case; the corpus grows per rule per milestone.
# AGLC4-CASE-002 — party separator is lowercase unpunctuated v (r 2.1.11)
# AGLC4-CASE-003 — no full stops in report series (r 1.6.1)
# AGLC4-CASE-004 — pinpoint follows page as ', pinpoint'
# AGLC4-CASE-005 — unknown report series (low confidence, Appendix A)
# AGLC4-CASE-006 — medium-neutral citations take square brackets (r 2.3.1)
# AGLC4-CASE-007 — volumed series require a volume number (r 2.2.1)
# Compound violations fire every applicable rule.
# Malformed inputs recover without diagnostics (no year bracket = gated out;
# structurally broken = unclassified, never confidently wrong).
# Published decisions only (court-assigned pseudonyms; public on AustLII);
# both verified in the 2026-06-03 authority-verification run. The CASE-006
# row is a deliberately malformed bracket variant of the real citation.
